column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# route-prompt offers WHICH tool; the reminder hooks nudge about WHAT to do — different jobs,
# so no shared territory. The yield is not invented here: the charter this hook injects already
# says "clarification outranks tool-fit" (hooks/route-prompt.sh, rule 3), so the row records a
# deference the plugin already ships. That charter is now backed by rank as well as prose —
# taskmaster:remind holds arcRank 25, ahead of every other arc voice — where until 2026-09-14
# it held 90 and lost to all of them. prime.sh (SessionStart), route.sh (PostToolUse) and
# summary.sh (SessionEnd) are outside the gated channel and carry no row this run.
# subagent-skills (SubagentStart) is outside it too and declares a row anyway: it speaks inside
# every plugin subagent, where candor:preamble also speaks, so its territory is written down.
# Phase `any` because a spawn can come at any point of the arc — a reviewer at review, a
# worker at build — and the hook reads no phase sentinel.
